name: Game
fix_description: In makeBid, follow checks-effects-interactions: update bidAddress and bidEther before calling _sendEther to refund the previous bidder. Or add a nonReentrant modifier. The current order allows reentrancy via the ETH refund call.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a straightforward reentrancy exploit against a bidding game with a simple logic flaw in the minimum-bid check. The PoC is short, uses one target contract, no flash loans or complex DeFi primitives, and the attack flow is just initial bid plus repeated reentrant bad bids.
